ops.body:
Accepted the root contract review of f078f23. cc-notes docs f078f23 and a8da144 are corrected before stage B:
(1) Session identity is preserved. There is no silent ModeRekey.
- A local copy that is identical or a strict prefix, and not live, is fast-forwarded in place under the same id.
- A divergent local copy makes pickup refuse with DivergentLocalError (JSON code divergent-local-copy) and keep both histories separate (the replica stays under ReplicaRoot; the local copy is untouched).
- Explicit intent only: --on-divergence=keep-local|replace|fork. replace moves the local copy intact to <Dir>/displaced/<sid>/<ts>/. fork is the only path that changes an id.
- A live-local collision always refuses.
(2) Pickup is one command. An interactive TTY pickup where Orca did not resume the selected session execs native `claude --resume <sid>` in the recovered worktree, with no work prompt. --json or non-interactive runs return per-session launch {argv, dir, env_unset, env_set} and never exec. The Orca picker always passes --json.
(3) There is no TestedVersions whitelist. Gating covers only concrete, detected incompatibilities:
- launch-capability probes against the destination claude, where extra flags are used only when advertised;
- storage-format probes.
Old source transcripts are resumed as-is by the newer destination CLI. Unknown record types are copied verbatim and any unrelocated paths are reported. Refusal is IncompatibleError{Capability, Detail} (JSON code incompatible). An unportable native rewrite shown by the fixtures gets escalated, never gated silently.
The stage-A branches cc-sync/cli and cc-sync/native-fixtures started before this correction; stage B integration adds the launch/divergence fields and exec behavior and removes any version whitelist.
